import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c4e1c142.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    patterns = []
    # Horizontal reference sequences are contiguous nonzero runs in top/bottom rows.
    for r in (0, h - 1):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            run = []
            while c < w and grid[r][c] != 0:
                run.append(grid[r][c])
                c += 1
            patterns.append(run)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[r][c]
            if not value:
                continue
            pattern = next(p for p in patterns if value in p)
            start = c - pattern.index(value)
            for i, color in enumerate(pattern):
                x = start + i
                if 0 <= x < w:
                    out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.exists())
